notes.title: Glitchball Update
notes.content:
Glitchball has recieved an update. 

[u] Fixes[/u]

[list]
    [*]Keyboard support added and warning has been removed
    [*]Sound effects slider added
    [*]Default sound has been lowered
    [*]Mac build added
    [*]Linux build added
    [*]Soundtrack will be released next week. 

[/list]

Ｔｈａｎｋ　ｙｏｕ　ｆｏｒ　ｐｌａｙｉｎｇ　ａｎｄ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｆｅｅｄｂａｃｋ．　Ｗｅ　ａｒｅ　ｏｖｅｒｊｏｙｅｄ　ｂｙ　ｔｈｅ　ｒｅｓｐｏｎｓｅ　ａｎｄ　ｈｏｐｅ　ｙｏｕ　ｅｎｊｏｙ　ｔｈｅ　ＯＳＴ．(to be released early next week)　　フ俺代逸蒸ツ　逸ふづヵ ホッ壱くズ波ボ胃移
